notes.title: Patch/Update
notes.content:
[b]Hello commanders[/b]

Death timer:
Added new death timer for player Mechs that increases per death so making it vital to not just go all in ever engagement.

BuildManager:
In commander view you can now select lanes to send your troops. this adds much more stratergy to the game making it possible to target locations and force a responce out of your enemy.
Updated buildmanager and added minimap to give a view of the battle while buying units.

Controller:
Still working on controller support, getting very close now to ingame xbox full control.

Visuals:
#Started work on updating the map and base visuals.
#Player Mech update
#Some particle cleaning
#Juggernaut being worked on, expected release soon

Many thanks to all supporting

notes.title: Update, New units, New visuals,Controller support
notes.content:
[b]Hello commanders[/b]

In this update we are releasing controller support in game, this is still being tweaked for comfort but gives the game more immersion. Let me know how it feels.

[b]Some more visuals have been updated and particles:[/b]
# Nukes
# Main weapon
# Explosions 
# Most Vehicles

[b]Lighting:[/b]
Lighting changes to fit the progress of the game giving a better visual appearance.

[b]New Released Units:[/b]
#Pitt49
This is a cheaper aircraft with duel gatling guns but has reasonable hp, this unit is for general poke and for distracting enemy fire.

#Anti nuke
Finally a way to counter those pesky nukes, make the call to either stop your base being obliterated or save the cash to launch a counter attack if you have nothing to lose at home.

Let me know what you think in discussions or anything new you would like to see

Many thanks to all giving me feedback.

notes.title: Patch notes
notes.content:
[b]Hello Commanders[/b]

[b]General info:[/b]
Its been a tough few weeks but have been busy fixing many naughty bugs and exploits posted, also have been updating visuals on some units to make them feel less blocky and more up to date. Following requests on balancing some adjustments have been made.

[b]Visuals:[/b]
[list]
[*] Tank
[*] Scout
[*] Jets
[*] Turrets
[*] Annihilators
[*] Choppers
[*] Main weapon
[/list]

Added better explosions to units so they split apart when they die so you feel more rewarded to 
take a unit down and make it go BOOM!

[b]Balancing:[/b]

Turret damage increase 15 to 20

Jet hp reduced 600 to 500
Jet Damage reduced 160 to 150

Annihilators hp reduced 1100 to 1000

Chopper damage increase 10 to 12
Chopper hp increase 100 to 130

Scout hp reduced 100 to 80
Scout reduced price $80 to $50

Player Mech
Rocket damage increased 50 to 60
Main gun Damage increase  15 to 20
Obviously upgrade on main weapon is still x2 sp 40
Main gun upgrade purchase price reduced $2000 to $1400


[b]Future progress:[/b]
Always I like to hear from community so keep letting me know features you wanna see, or sneaky bugs you find it all helps shape the game.
I have had a heavy request for controller support so that should be out next patch so quite soon.
New unit to be added soon as requested a radar jammer that will temporarily disable enemy radar used for sneaky attacks or hiding your next move from your opponent forcing them to have to come and see whats coming before its too late.

Many thanks commanders, its been tough being a solo developer but together we can keep the ball rolling and build the game how we want it :)

notes.title: Balancing and Bugfixes
notes.content:
Hello commanders

Just a small update on bugfixes and balancing, after some feedback we found some little bugs hiding away and hopefully have solved these.

few minor balances from the community

- turret hp raised
- scouts movement speed increased
- player mech damage increased 
- reset neutral turret decreased
- generators cash increased (overall gold per sec decreased)
- Jets damage decreased but speed increased for swift attacks

Many thanks look forward to more updates

notes.title: Community feedback
notes.content:
Hi commanders

As the game progresses i would like some community feedback in discusions or reviews, this will help me to shape the game and come up with new ideas to implement.

[u]Things to consider[/u]
[list]
[*] Do you think somthing is unbalanced?
[*] Do you think a unit is unbalanced? 
[*] New unit ideas
[*] Map features
[*] Commander upgrades
[/list]

A few ideas to get the ball rolling of what you may wish to talk about.

Id realy like to set up a ranked tournament soon to see if we can find who is the best Commander and see what stratergies people have come up with to win, this would also give me new ideas to tweak the battle.

Thanks
Mozza

News

Update will be coming soon with some changes and balancing, anyone wishing to help in the testing and feedback please mail me in discussions

notes.title: Update v1.024
notes.content:
Hello everyone

The games progress is coming along nicely and you may have seen many small updates over the weekend this is due to testing.
Thanks to the testers we found many bugs and have resolved them so keep finding them please : )

Whats new:

Unit updates:
A few models have been reworked and cleaned up and minor balancing.
including Chopper, Tank and annihilator

Sounds:
A few sounds added here and there but will change when i have found the right ones but atleast the backend code is their and gives a player some indication of events

Leader board:
in this patch I have linked steam to the game properly so your steam name shall appear now so you do not have to manually add it. 
This has enabled me to release the start of the Leader board. this means winning games against players not against AI will score you points and add you to the leader board. (still working progress but working enough now for testing)

UI:
A mech UI has been given with health, stamina and rocket ammo added to keep an eye on your mech stats

Many thanks speak to you all soon
